about.title: About the Project
about.p1: The Democracy Game is a political simulation of decision-making. Players can choose between several different political environments, and between the role of powerful individuals or ordinary citizens, and then experience evolving dilemmas that walk the line between personal lives and the public sphere. The goal of the game is to serve as a tool for exploring decision-making processes and self-identity perception, as well as an educational tool for encouraging political awareness and literacy. The game emphasizes issues of liberalism, autonomy, and democracy, and provides players with constant feedback on how daily dilemmas relate to these values.
about.p2: In the game, we use an extensive theoretical background and generative artificial intelligence to challenge players' values and respond to their choices dynamically, as well as to provide feedback and reflect on values, considerations, and insights resulting from their actions.

splash.subtitle: Choose your path, know thyself
splash.description: Dive into a unique political simulation where you call the shots. Pick a scenario, step into a role, and face real-world dilemmas filled with tough trade-offs and unexpected consequences. Every decision surfaces values, priorities, and perspectives—turning politics into an engaging and educational experience.

consent.text: This game is part of a research study. Your choices are recorded anonymously for academic analysis.
consent.info_details: This study is conducted by researchers from Hebrew University, Tel Aviv University, Technion, and Bar-Ilan University. The game presents political dilemmas to analyze decision-making patterns. No personally identifiable information is collected. Participation is voluntary, and you may stop at any time. For questions, please contact the research team.
